Step 1: I see "she". Step 2: I add -s to the verb.
Rule: he, she or it + verb with -s.
Right: She works on Mondays. Wrong: She work on Mondays.
Now you. Write only the verb:
Write the correct form: My sister ___ (play) tennis on Sundays. (answer with only the verb)
